description.summary: The caster emulates a black nakk’s ability to enhance herself or an ally with great magical strength
description.value: The caster emulates a black nakk’s ability to enhance herself or an ally with great magical strength. This spell functions like magic fang , except that the enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls is +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5). This bonus does not allow a natural weapon or unarmed strike to bypass damage reduction aside from magic. Alternatively, you may imbue all of the creature’s natural weapons with a +1 enhancement bonus (regardless of your caster level).
